1613531b3b.q: What is the Redbox+ Dumpsters Elite Dumpster and what makes it unique in the waste management market?
1613531b3b.a: The Elite Dumpster is a patented product consisting of two portable toilets attached to the front of a 20- or 30-yard dumpster. When a contractor calls, they get two services with one call, and they always have a toilet on site that is cleaned at least every seven days. However, the real differentiator is customer service: Redbox+ guarantees that within 24 hours franchisees will either have a dumpster on site or will pick up, empty and return one if needed.

2a3a1bf433.q: What startup equipment requirements does Redbox+ Dumpsters recommend for new franchisees?
2a3a1bf433.a: Redbox+ recommends franchisees start with two trucks because if one truck goes down, operations are severely impacted. The company also recommends approximately 60 to 70 dumpsters at startup, with 42 being the minimum, but they advise starting with more to ensure franchisees have enough equipment for their first year to year and a half of operations.

f: Kaizen is a concept of constant improvement that Sean Foley has embraced as a devotee to the philosophy. As brand president of Redbox+ Dumpsters, Foley applies this approach by continuously pushing forward and improving rather than allowing the company to rest on its current success. He emphasizes that catching oneself thinking "this is good enough" is a critical mistake, as there is always competition and someone trying to overtake you. This mindset drives the organization to protect the brand and ensure franchisees have the tools needed to succeed.

Foley has implemented multiple initiatives reflecting his commitment to Kaizen. The company has invested heavily in maintenance programs and brought Blue Book prospecting tools to franchisees at no additional cost. Additionally, Redbox+ changed its purchasing policies to allow franchisees to buy dumpsters from any local fabricator rather than exclusively from the company, enabling faster growth. This policy shift came from a conversation with a potential customer whose family ties to a competing dumpster business created barriers to using Redbox+ equipment, leading Foley to realize franchisees needed flexibility to grow quickly without accumulating excess debt.
